backups_operation_failed: The operation could not be finalized. Check storage diagnostics before trying again.
backups_restore_verified: :count file(s) restored and verified. Temporary recovery copy removed.
backups_restore_health_check_failed: The restored generation did not restart correctly. The restoration was rolled back.
backups_subtitle: Create, store, download, and restore site data and media from a ZIP archive.
backups_zip_missing: The ZIP extension is not available on this server.
backups_create_hint: The archive contains JSON and HTML data, media, avatars and, when needed, the encrypted instance key. Keep its restore key separately.
backups_reset_hint: Empties site content and media while keeping accounts, modules, languages, themes, and core settings intact.
backups_reset_warning: Content, menus, footer, forms, trash and media will be cleared. The temporary recovery copy is removed after file verification.
backups_reset_confirm: Do you really want to reset FlatCMS? Content and media will be cleared. Create a manual backup first if you want to keep it.
backups_reset_success: FlatCMS has been reset and its files verified. Temporary copy removed.
backups_site_reset_hint: Deletes all site data and customizations while keeping only the oldest Super Admin and the technical state required by FlatCMS.
backups_site_reset_warning: All other accounts, settings, content, media, logos, custom translations, integrations, API keys, licenses, forms, private attachments and trash items will be deleted. Modules, extensions, plugins and themes added after FlatCMS installation will also be removed. Existing backups are preserved.
backups_site_reset_confirm: Do you really want to delete all site data? Only the oldest Super Admin will be kept. Existing backups will remain available.
backups_site_reset_success: Site data has been deleted. The original Super Admin and existing backups were preserved.
backups_site_reset_super_admin_missing: No valid Super Admin was found. The reset was cancelled.
backups_factory_reset_hint: Deletes all runtime data, re-enables the Install module, and restarts the installer from step 1.
backups_factory_reset_warning: Accounts, settings, content, media, translations, forms, private attachments, installed.lock, and all locally stored SiteBackup and FullBackup archives will be deleted. Download any backups you want to keep before continuing.
backups_factory_reset_confirm: Do you really want to start over? FlatCMS will delete all runtime data and all locally stored SiteBackup and FullBackup archives, reactivate Install, and return you to installation step 1.
backups_factory_reset_sensitive_hint: All private keys (API keys, tokens, licenses, etc.) will be permanently deleted.
backups_restore_hint: Upload a ZIP archive generated by FlatCMS or restore an archive already stored on this installation.
backups_restore_warning: Restore replaces site data and media. The temporary recovery copy is removed after file verification. Manual backups are kept.
backups_restore_confirm: This restore will replace the current site data together with its media. Continue?
backups_delete_confirm: Do you really want to delete this backup?
backups_upload_hint: Use a FlatCMS SiteBackup archive. If a recovery key was created with this backup, add it as well.
backups_upload_key_hint: The recovery key is optional for backups that do not use one. It is required only when one was generated with the backup.
backups_upload_failed: Unable to upload the ZIP archive.
backups_upload_too_large: The ZIP archive is too large for this server.
backups_upload_partial: The ZIP archive upload is incomplete.
backups_list_hint: :count archive(s) stored in the dedicated backup area.
backups_dashboard_text: Create a backup, restore an archive, or reset site content from the Backups module.
backups_scope_value: JSON and HTML data, media, private avatars, and an encrypted instance key with a separate restore key
backups_storage_unavailable: The backup directory is not writable.
backups_error_no_data: No backupable JSON or media file was found.
backups_archive_open_failed: Unable to open the ZIP archive.
backups_archive_invalid: The ZIP archive contains invalid or unauthorized paths.
backups_archive_invalid_json: The archive contains an invalid JSON file.
backups_archive_empty: The archive does not contain any usable JSON or media data.
backups_archive_write_failed: Unable to write the backup ZIP archive.
backups_restore_write_failed: Unable to write restored files to disk.
backups_delete_failed: Unable to delete the backup archive.
backups_help_intro: Use Backups before any heavy operation so you keep a portable archive of your data, media files, and private avatars.
backups_help_step_create: Create an archive before a migration, a major redesign, or a reset.
backups_help_step_restore: Test a restore on another instance to confirm that content and media come back cleanly.
backups_help_step_reset: Use reset only after confirming that a recent backup is available.
backups_empty_text: Create a first backup now to secure the instance before the next changes, imports, or restore tests.
backups_key_not_found: The restore key associated with this archive could not be found.
backups_site_key_invalid: The SiteBackup key is missing, invalid, or does not match this archive.
backups_site_key_exists: A SiteBackup key with this name already exists.
backups_site_key_write_failed: The SiteBackup key could not be stored.
backups_site_openssl_required: OpenSSL is required to protect SiteBackup secrets.
backups_site_secret_invalid: The encrypted SiteBackup secret is invalid.
backups_site_secret_encrypt_failed: The SiteBackup secret could not be encrypted.
backups_site_secret_decrypt_failed: The SiteBackup secret could not be authenticated or decrypted.
backups_site_baseline_missing: The SiteBackup portability baseline is missing.
backups_site_baseline_invalid: The SiteBackup portability baseline is invalid.
backups_site_baseline_manifest_invalid: A native component manifest is invalid for portability checks.
backups_site_baseline_path_invalid: A portability baseline path is invalid.
backups_site_baseline_read_failed: A file required for portability checks could not be read.
backups_site_baseline_root_missing: An expected native FlatCMS component is missing.
backups_site_baseline_symlink_forbidden: An unexpected symbolic link prevents the portability check.
backups_site_baseline_version_missing: The FlatCMS version could not be determined.
backups_site_baseline_write_failed: The SiteBackup portability baseline could not be saved.
backups_site_portability_blocked: The portable backup is blocked because the Core, a native module, or a native theme has been modified.
backups_site_target_portability_blocked: The restore is blocked because the target installation no longer matches its FlatCMS Core baseline.
backups_site_version_incompatible: This portable backup was created with a different FlatCMS version than the target installation.
backups_site_portable_settings_invalid: The sensitive settings carried by this backup are invalid or unreadable.
backups_site_portable_license_invalid: A licence carried by this backup is invalid or unreadable.
backups_restore_assets_failed: Public assets could not be published. The restore was cancelled.
